newsitem.title: SOUTH AFRICA: Don Group sells property for six mln rand.
newsitem.headline: Don Group sells property for six mln rand.

text.p: The Don Group said on Tuesday it would use six million rand in proceeds from the sale of a commercial property in the Johannesburg city centre to reduce the group's gearing.

Chairman Marc Wainer said the sale conformed with the group's strategy to sell off the property portfolio inherited when it acquired Bristol Industrial Corp in a reverse takeover and listing on the Johannesburg Stock Exchange in November 1994.
Looking ahead, Wainer said that the Don Apartments would benefit from the apparent stabilising in the rand this year and business confidence's cautious return.
This follows in the wake of some hotel refurbishments and contractor delays in finishing new properties in the first half of 1996 which had impacted on occupancy levels.
